verdict.rationale: Bolt supports GitHub sync (connect repo, create/import repo, automatic commit backup) which lets a developer pull the project locally, edit with their own tools, and push changes back, and Bolt will sync those commits [bolt-docs-2][bolt-docs-30][bolt-docs-31][bolt-docs-4]. However, the primary editing model is browser-based 'Code view' and there is no documented local CLI, local dev-server parity, or explicit workflow guidance for round-tripping local edits back into Bolt outside of git push/pull. Missing for 10: dedicated local-dev tooling/CLI, documentation of how local edits merge with Bolt's live environment, and independent confirmation that this workflow works smoothly in practice.
